"    WITH
      ActivityEvents AS (
        SELECT TimestampLocal
        FROM (
          SELECT
            TimestampLocal,
            ((X - LAG(X) OVER w) * (X - LAG(X) OVER w) +
             (Y - LAG(Y) OVER w) * (Y - LAG(Y) OVER w) +
             (Z - LAG(Z) OVER w) * (Z - LAG(Z) OVER w)) AS magChange
          FROM Magnetometer
          WHERE TimestampLocal BETWEEN ?1 AND ?2
          WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY TimestampLocal)
        )
        WHERE magChange > 5
      ),
      Segments AS (
        SELECT
          LAG(TimestampLocal) OVER (ORDER BY TimestampLocal) AS start_ts,
          TimestampLocal AS end_ts,
          (TimestampLocal - LAG(TimestampLocal) OVER (ORDER BY TimestampLocal)) / 60000.0 AS duration_minutes
        FROM ActivityEvents
      ),
      FilteredSegments AS (
        SELECT *
        FROM (
          SELECT *,
            CAST(
              CASE
                WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%H', start_ts / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) < 12
                  THEN (CAST(STRFTIME('%H', start_ts / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) + 24) * 60
                  ELSE CAST(STRFTIME('%H', start_ts / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) * 60
              END
              + CAST(STRFTIME('%M', start_ts / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER)
            AS REAL) / 60.0 AS segment_start_hour
          FROM Segments
          WHERE duration_minutes >= 90
        )
        WHERE segment_start_hour BETWEEN 21 AND 27
      ),
      WithGaps AS (
        SELECT
          *,
          LAG(end_ts) OVER (ORDER BY start_ts) AS prev_end_ts,
          (start_ts - LAG(end_ts) OVER (ORDER BY start_ts)) / 60000.0 AS gap_minutes
        FROM FilteredSegments
      ),
      Sessions AS (
        SELECT *,
          SUM(CASE WHEN gap_minutes IS NULL OR gap_minutes > 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
          OVER (ORDER BY start_ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS session_id
        FROM WithGaps
      ),
      SessionBounds AS (
        SELECT
          session_id,
          MIN(start_ts) AS session_start,
          MAX(end_ts) AS session_end,
          (MAX(end_ts) - MIN(start_ts)) / 1000.0 AS session_duration
        FROM Sessions
        GROUP BY session_id
      ),
      RankedSessions AS (
        SELECT *,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY DATE(session_start/1000, 'unixepoch', '-12 hours')
            ORDER BY session_duration DESC
          ) AS rn
        FROM SessionBounds
      )
    SELECT
      CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', session_start/1000, 'unixepoch', '-12 hours') AS INTEGER) AS year,
      CAST(STRFTIME('%m', session_start/1000, 'unixepoch', '-12 hours') AS INTEGER) AS month,
      CAST(STRFTIME('%d', session_start/1000, 'unixepoch', '-12 hours') AS INTEGER) AS day,
      CAST(STRFTIME('%H', session_start/1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
      CAST(STRFTIME('%M', session_start/1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) * 60 +
      CAST(STRFTIME('%S', session_start/1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) AS seconds_from_midnight
    FROM RankedSessions
    WHERE rn = 1
    ORDER BY session_start;"

"    WITH
    ActivityEvents AS (
      SELECT TimestampLocal
      FROM (
        SELECT
          TimestampLocal,
          (X - LAG(X,1,X) OVER w)*(X - LAG(X,1,X) OVER w) +
          (Y - LAG(Y,1,Y) OVER w)*(Y - LAG(Y,1,Y) OVER w) +
          (Z - LAG(Z,1,Z) OVER w)*(Z - LAG(Z,1,Z) OVER w) AS magChange
        FROM Magnetometer
        WHERE TimestampLocal BETWEEN ?1 AND ?2
        WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY TimestampLocal)
      )
      WHERE magChange > 5
    ),
    InactivityPeriods AS (
      SELECT
        TimestampLocal AS night_end_candidate_ts,
        (TimestampLocal - LAG(TimestampLocal) OVER (ORDER BY TimestampLocal)) / 60000.0 AS duration_minutes
      FROM ActivityEvents
    ),
    FilteredInactivity AS (
      SELECT *
      FROM InactivityPeriods
      WHERE duration_minutes > 100
        AND (CAST(STRFTIME('%H', night_end_candidate_ts/1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) * 60 +
             CAST(STRFTIME('%M', night_end_candidate_ts/1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER))
            BETWEEN 4*60 AND 10*60
    ),
    RankedInactivity AS (
      SELECT *,
             DATE(night_end_candidate_ts/1000, 'unixepoch', '-12 hours') AS bucket_day,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY DATE(night_end_candidate_ts/1000, 'unixepoch', '-12 hours')
               ORDER BY duration_minutes DESC
             ) AS rn
      FROM FilteredInactivity
    )
    SELECT
      CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', night_end_candidate_ts/1000, 'unixepoch', '-12 hours') AS INTEGER) AS year,
      CAST(STRFTIME('%m', night_end_candidate_ts/1000, 'unixepoch', '-12 hours') AS INTEGER) AS month,
      CAST(STRFTIME('%d', night_end_candidate_ts/1000, 'unixepoch', '-12 hours') AS INTEGER) AS day,
      /* seconds_from_midnight: NO '-12 hours' */
      CAST(STRFTIME('%H', night_end_candidate_ts/1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
      CAST(STRFTIME('%M', night_end_candidate_ts/1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) * 60 +
      CAST(STRFTIME('%S', night_end_candidate_ts/1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) AS seconds_from_midnight
    FROM RankedInactivity
    WHERE rn = 1
    ORDER BY night_end_candidate_ts;"
